Apple (AAPL) Stake Held by Miracle Mile Advisors Llc; Avalon Advisors Raised Its Holding in Ternium Sa (TX) by $1.60 Million
May 30, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy
Miracle Mile Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 77.27% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Miracle Mile Advisors Llc bought 43,058 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 98,783 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $16.57 million, up from 55,725 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Miracle Mile Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $920.80B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.30% or $0.56 during the last trading session, reaching $187.34. About 12.91M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Avalon Advisors Llc increased its stake in Ternium Sa (TX) by 195.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Avalon Advisors Llc bought 50,111 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.11% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 75,791 shares of the steel and iron ore company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.46 million, up from 25,680 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Avalon Advisors Llc who had been investing in Ternium Sa for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.08 billion market cap company. It closed at $36.07 lastly. It is down 46.05% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.48% the S&P500.
Avalon Advisors Llc, which manages about $4.06B and $3.30 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in First Horizon Natl Corp (NYSE:FHN) by 58,700 shares to 76,110 shares, valued at $1.43 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Pfizer Inc (NYSE:PFE) by 193,427 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.66 million shares, and cut its stake in Philip Morris Intl Inc (NYSE:PM).
